```{r}
#| label: outcomesroc
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false

roc_obj <- roc(response = escdata$death_baseline_C, predictor = escdata$Bili_mgdL, quiet = T)
# Find the optimal cut-off using Youden's J statistic (Sensitivity + Specificity - 1)
cutoff_deathinhosp <- fn(coords(roc_obj, x = "best", ret = "threshold", best.method = "youden")[[1]], 2)

roc_obj <- roc(response = escdata$death_fup, predictor = escdata$Bili_mgdL, quiet = T)
# Find the optimal cut-off using Youden's J statistic (Sensitivity + Specificity - 1)
cutoff_deathfu <- fn(coords(roc_obj, x = "best", ret = "threshold", best.method = "youden")[[1]], 2)
```
